name: Anti-Spam
description: Simple anti-spam protection: honeypot fields, rate limiting, keyword blocklist, and IP blocking.
author: Ikabud Kernel Team

body.description: Text body to scan for blocked keywords

ip.description: IP address to check (defaults to request IP)

settings_fields.label: Enable Anti-Spam
settings_fields.description: Master switch for anti-spam protections on this tenant.

settings_fields.label: Protect Public Web APIs
settings_fields.description: Apply anti-spam checks automatically to unauthenticated module API requests handled through the web runtime.

settings_fields.label: Skip Authenticated API Users
settings_fields.description: Avoid applying the default API anti-spam gate to already-authenticated users.

settings_fields.label: Enable Honeypot Detection
settings_fields.description: Allow forms to use honeypot fields for bot detection.

settings_fields.label: Enable Rate Limiting
settings_fields.description: Limit repeated requests from the same client IP.

settings_fields.label: Rate Limit Window (seconds)
settings_fields.description: How far back to count recent requests when rate limiting.

settings_fields.label: Rate Limit Max Requests
settings_fields.description: Maximum allowed requests per IP within the configured window.

settings_fields.label: Enable Keyword Blocklist
settings_fields.description: Scan request bodies for blocked phrases.

settings_fields.label: Blocked Keywords
settings_fields.default: viagra,casino,lottery,nigerian prince,click here now,buy now cheap
settings_fields.description: Comma-separated words or phrases that should trigger a block.

settings_fields.label: Log Retention Days
settings_fields.description: How many days of anti-spam log history to keep when clearing old records.

events.description: A request was blocked by anti-spam
A honeypot field was filled (bot detected)
